title: Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) Filing-Fee Schedule for a Fee Charged Again: Fee, Floor and Ceiling
content:
**1. Fee.** Under Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44), a fee charged again is the fee charged on a filing whose fee charges were all reversed in full as charged in error. Its standard amount is Cardinal Point's flat filing fee for a fee charged again: 25.00 US dollars, to the cent.

**2. Ledger figures.** Two figures are read from the filing's own fee ledger:

- *the fees reversed on the filing:* the amounts of its fee reversals, taken together;
- *the fee standing on it:* its fee charges less its fee reversals, never below zero.

**3. Settlement.** The schedule settles the fee charged again in this order:

1. A figure that takes the place of the flat fee is set first.
2. Every amount added under the schedule is added to that figure.
3. That total is never below the minimum re-charge of 10.00.
4. The fee charged again is then never more than the fees reversed on the filing less any fee still standing on it.
5. The result is rounded to the cent, half up, once at the end.

Each dimension of the schedule enters the fee once.

**4. Worked figures (hypothetical ledgers)**

| Fee ledger of the filing | Fees reversed | Fee standing | Ceiling | Fee charged again |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| one charge of 40.00, one reversal of 40.00 | 40.00 | 0.00 | 40.00 | 25.00 (flat fee, above 10.00 and within 40.00) |
| one charge of 18.00, one reversal of 18.00 | 18.00 | 0.00 | 18.00 | 18.00 (flat fee 25.00 held to the ceiling) |
